Threat -> answer: two allied armies out-producing the player -> the avenues meet at the square (ART on the square, Tanks in the parks); enemy air from the two airports (and the neutral one) -> the player's own airport (Fighters) and AA from the bases; ART duels -> Recon to find them, Tanks to close; the missile silo (3 HP to everything within 3 cells) can be fired by anyone with a foot soldier on it; the race is won by taking the neutral towns first.
